page.overview:
Who is Benathar?

is a powerful mage defeated by Beauregard Lionett and Caleb Widogast as well as potentially other members of the Mighty Nein between Campaign Two and Campaign Three (between 836 and 843 PD).

All that is known of Benathar is from an offhand comment by Beauregard, when Caleb mentioned that many powerful mages feared Ludinus Da'leth. Beauregard responded, "Oh bullshit! We fucked up Halas. We fucked up Trent. We fucked up Benathar. Just another mage to add to the tally. Right? Just mark another tally piece."
